raw.rationale: Pomalidomide is a CRBN E3-ligase modulator with well-documented selective activity in multiple myeloma and some lymphoid malignancies, but PRISM adherent solid-tumor lineages generally lack the IKZF1/IKZF3 and CRBN-dependent sensitivity seen in myeloma; at 2.5 µM for 5 days, broad nonselective cytotoxicity is possible but lineage-selective killing of solid tumor lineages is unlikely. Published PRISM/CTRP data show pomalidomide is not a potent selective killer across most solid lineages, with only rare lineage-specific signals.
